Callees the page does not name are cited by call site only, so several rows read alike: 0034B0A0 and 0034CCF0, 0034B710 and 0034D2B0, 0034BAB0 and 0034D640, 0034BF40 and 0034C900 are pairs with the same shape but different (unnamed) tail or guarded callees; 0033FFC0 and 0034A290 likewise differ only in the first callee. 001B5610: the first unnamed call gets rcx+0xd0 and the incoming rdx untouched (rdx is not reloaded before it); the call at +0x5D gets the result of the call at +0x55 as rcx (stated as 'fed by'); the call at +0xC3 likewise gets the +0xB5 call's result as rcx; the indirect call at +0xA1 goes through the import slot 008C3038 with r8 = the first qword of the 001B31E0 output; the two cleanup blocks compare signed (jle) and pass r8d = low dword of end minus start (for rdx: dword [rdx+0x10] minus the low dword of qword [rdx]); no return value is set. 00348580: comiss/jb skips the maxss when a is below 0.0 or unordered (NaN); maxss(b, a) returns a when either is NaN. 00348A90: maxss(0.0, a) yields a when a is NaN. 003490F0/00349460/003498D0/0034B0A0-style tail calls do not test the 003EB720 result for null; 00348580/00348A90/0034BF40/0034C900 do.
